name: 就医场景文本
desc: 挂号、描述症状、见医生、缴费取药的常用句
descEn: Common phrases for registration, symptoms, doctor visits, payment and pharmacy
author: ZiTan 社区 / ZiTan Community

deaf.t: 我听不见，请打字或者看我的手机屏幕
deaf.en: I'm deaf — please type or look at my phone

deaf.t: 请面对我慢慢说，我可以看口型
deaf.en: Please face me and speak slowly, I can read lips

deaf.t: 我想挂号，请问挂哪个科
deaf.en: I'd like to register. Which department?
Where do I queue for registration?

deaf.t: 我没有医保卡，用自费可以吗
deaf.en: I don't have insurance — can I pay myself?

deaf.t: 这里不舒服，请看我指的位置
deaf.en: It hurts here — please look where I point
It started three days ago
I have a slight fever, I measured it
The pain is moderate

deaf.t: 吃过这个药，请看我手机
deaf.en: I took this medicine — please look at my phone
I'm allergic to this medicine

deaf.t: 我做过什么检查，请看我手机里的报告
deaf.en: I had these tests done — look at my phone
Where do I get my blood drawn?
How long until the results come out?
Where do I pick up the report?
How should I take this medicine?

deaf.t: 一天几次，一次几粒，请写下来
deaf.en: How many times a day? Please write it down
Where do I pay?
Where is the pharmacy?
Please book my follow-up appointment

deaf.t: 我还要注意什么，请写下来
deaf.en: What else should I watch? Please write it down
I can't hear — please write it again
Thank you, doctor

vol.t: 我是志愿者，来帮您沟通的
vol.en: I'm a volunteer here to help you communicate

vol.t: 请您打字或者用手机告诉我
vol.en: Please type or use your phone to tell me

vol.t: 您哪里不舒服，请指给我看
vol.en: Where do you feel unwell? Please show me

vol.t: 这个问题我去问一下医生
vol.en: Let me ask the doctor about that

vol.t: 缴费在一楼窗口，我带您去
vol.en: Payment is on the first floor, I'll take you
The pharmacy is on the third floor, follow me

vol.t: 结果出来我再告诉您，请先坐一下
vol.en: Have a seat — I'll tell you when results are ready
